name: @equin/plugin-database-pgbouncer-publish-watch
description: Watches the daily Build and Publish workflow of equinai/pgbouncer-embedded on GitHub (GitHubEvents.Watch), so a failed publish of the @equin/pgbouncer-* packages files a report. A leaf child: database imports pgbouncer, and github-events stands on database, so the watch cannot sit in pgbouncer's own barrel.
